name: Mini DB Engine
stats: 8/8 eval cases · B+tree index · crash-safe WAL
content: Mini DB Engine (Systems from Scratch): "A real database, with no database library underneath.". How does a database actually keep your data safe? This engine answers that with 4 KB pages, a B+tree index, an LRU buffer pool, write-ahead logging and transactions. A no-steal, force-at-commit design means recovery only ever has to redo, never undo. Key highlights: **Crash recovery made simple** by designing the buffer policy around it. **Index proven under pressure** by forcing multiple root splits. Honest limitation/tradeoff: A learning engine, not tuned for speed or concurrency. Verified metrics: 8/8 eval cases · B+tree index · crash-safe WAL.
